verdict.rationale: Slate lets developers set preferred default models for each slot through the `/models` dialog or the `models` key in `slate.json`. Model sources span providers, including ChatGPT/Codex and SuperGrok subscriptions or Slate credits, and docs show Claude, GLM and Codex mixed across roles. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported models and providers, documentation of switching models mid-session rather than only setting defaults (auto-selection is the headline behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
